explication: Apache HBase is a distributed, versioned, column-oriented store modeled after Bigtable and built on Hadoop storage. Its principal workflow is a client issuing table operations against regions hosted by region servers, where stores manage persisted data. The graph also preserves major runtime capabilities visible in the repository tree: cluster placement, replication, backup and restore, access control, and service interfaces. Several connections are dashed because the relevant runtime wiring is not shown in the excerpts; the README establishes HBase’s Hadoop-backed storage model.
